questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

You snooze, you lose

options.text: If you oversleep, you are likely to lose a job
You may lose your money if snoozing is not stopped
If you are not alert, you are likely to miss opportunities.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "**If you are not alert, you are likely to miss opportunities**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• The idiom "**You snooze, you lose**" means that if you are not alert and attentive, you are likely to miss out on opportunities. (अगर आप सतर्क और ध्यानदेने में अक्षम हैं, तो आपके लिए अवसर चूकने की संभावना है)

 
 
• **Example**: *She wanted to buy that limited-edition item, but she hesitated, and now it's sold out. You know what they say, "You snooze, you lose."*
 
 
 
• The phrase implies that being lazy or inactive can lead to missed chances.
 
• The idiom is often used in contexts such as sports, business, or relationships where quick thinking and decisive action are important.
 
• The phrase can also be used as a warning to someone who is not paying attention or not taking a situation seriously.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

You have adopted the plan.

options.text: The plan should be adopted by you.
The plan is adopted by you.
The plan has being adopted by you.
The plan has been adopted by you.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **The plan has been adopted by you.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is written in the **present perfect tense**.

 
 
• **Active Voice Structure** (Present Perfect Tense): Subject + have/has + past participle (V3) + Object__
 
• **Passive Voice Structure** (Present Perfect Tense): __Object + has/have been + past participle (V3) + by + Subject__
 
 
 
• The sentence is in active voice, with the subject '**you**' performing the action of adopting the plan.
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object of the sentence ('**the plan**') the subject, and use a form of 'be' + past participle of the verb ('**been adopted**') to show that the action has been done to the subject.
 
• The preposition '**by**' is used to show who performed the action (in this case, 'you').
 
• The sentence in passive voice becomes '*The plan has been adopted by you*.'

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
